Now I understand the hash computation. The hash is computed as:
```
hash = x0 ^ (x1 << 1) ^ (x2 << 2) ^ ... ^ (x15 << 15)
```

Where x0..x15 are the 16 bytes of the marker.

For `riff_HASH16`:
```
riff_HASH16 = 'r' ^ ('i' << 1) ^ ('f' << 2) ^ ('f' << 3) ^ (0x2E << 4) ^ (0x91 << 5) ^ (0xCF << 6) ^ (0x11 << 7) ^ (0xA5 << 8) ^ (0xD6 << 9) ^ (0x28 << 10) ^ (0xDB << 11) ^ (0x04 << 12) ^ (0xC1 << 13) ^ (0x00 << 14) ^ (0x00 << 15)
```
